rooms.definition: A room primarily used for sleeping or overnight rest.
A shared room primarily used for common activities, receiving guests, or relaxation.
A room primarily used for meals.
A room primarily used to prepare or cook food.
A room primarily used for personal washing, bathing, or toilet use.
A room primarily used for desk-based work or study.
A room primarily used to store belongings.
A room or area primarily used to move between other spaces.

notes: Ontology IDs and scope follow ROOM_BELIEF_V1_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.vi.md.
Prompt completions are a versioned wording proposal and have not been evaluated or approved as calibrated prompts.
Unknown/ambiguous/stale are output states, not additional LM softmax classes.
No room ground truth, scene annotation, or detector output is bundled in this file.
